label: echoed x as copy input at recall positions 1-2 (x was orig token 0 or 1), with >=3 outputs remaining
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (99% of mass) when the fed-back input is the letter x and that x is an early original token: recall_idx 1 (x was the first original token, input right after <DEL>; 66% of mass, strongest activations) or recall_idx 2 (x was the second original token). Essentially silent for x echoed at later copy positions, on x in the original phase, and on the delimiter. Magnitude grows with how many outputs remain (longer sequences, to_go 5-7 strongest); it is weak or absent when to_go <= 2, i.e. short sequences (L = 3-4). A second consecutive x (xx...) activates at about half strength. Small residual activations on n, 1, f echoed at the same early positions.

issues: The claims hold up. All activation is in the copy phase (share 1.000), none in the original or delimiter phases. in_tok x carries 0.992 of the mass, and n, 1 and f account for small residuals (0.006, 0.001, 0.001). By recall_idx: 1 has 0.656 of the mass, 2 has 0.343, 3 has 0.002 and later has 0. x echoed at recall_idx >= 3 has precision 0.004.

The to_go dependence is real but graded, not a sharp cutoff. Precision at recall_idx 1 for to_go 2 through 7 is 0.39 / 0.71 / 0.92 / 0.99 / 1.00 / 1.00. At recall_idx 2 for to_go 2 through 6 it is 0.12 / 0.65 / 0.90 / 0.97 / 0.99. Almost all false positives therefore sit at to_go 3-4, the edge of the threshold. With to_go >= 5 precision is 0.99. Raising the cutoff to to_go >= 4 lowers test F1 to 0.851, so >= 3 is the best single cutoff.

No other systematic class of false positives turned up. Repeated x in the original (in_count >= 2) has precision 0.88, close to 0.91 for in_count == 1. Excluding x-after-x at recall_idx 2 does not raise precision (0.88). Every predicted step has correct == 1, so model copy errors play no part.
Missed activations on test hold only 2.4% of the mass. They are weak (relative activation 0.02-0.13) and are mostly x at to_go 2, i.e. short sequences, plus scattered n.

Minor imprecision in the explanation: to_go <= 2 means L <= 4 at recall_idx 1 but L <= 5 at recall_idx 2, so 'covers L = 3-4' is only approximate. The 'xx at about half strength' magnitude claim was not checked directly, but xx is rare (356 steps).
